name: aligned_small
note: Four one-hot patterns. The label matches the reset wiring.

name: permuted_small
note: Same four patterns. The label is rotated, so the reset wiring is wrong.

name: switched_small
note: Train the aligned labels, then train the rotated labels. Test both regimes.

name: noisy_small
note: Aligned labels, plus one extra active input that is not the class.

name: random_small
note: Random 4-bit patterns and random labels. There is no class structure.

name: distinct64
note: Ten classes on 64 inputs. Each class owns three pixels and shares none. The pixels sit past the eight inputs a reset mux can see.

name: distinct64_3layer
note: The same disjoint classes through three mux layers. A recruited spike has to cross each layer.

name: glyphs64
note: Ten 8x8 digit drawings. Strokes overlap, so the earliest ink pixel is not private to one class.

name: glyphs64_noise
note: Digit drawings plus three random pixels in addresses 0..15. Those addresses are exactly where a reset mux looks, and they change between samples.

name: permuted_3layer
note: Rotated labels again, with three hidden mux layers instead of one.
